description: Implementation of TransactionService handling payment transactions, including creation, listing, and retrieval of capturable and refundable transactions within a payment processing system.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing transaction-related operations such as creation, listing, and retrieval of specific transaction types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction, serializing its details to JSON if not blank.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions associated with an order, parsing JSON details into a map.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction eligible for capture based on authorization status.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction eligible for refund, considering transaction types and dates.
